F-0907fa584356.reason: ss-12's item page already specifies the bulk POST /api/v1/import, its single transaction and its conflict reporting, and ADR 0007 decision 6 names the import (ss-12). The ADR is the record of the API shape, not of ss-12's endpoint; ss-12 plans it. Editing the ADR now would stale the approved technical approval for no behavioural gain.

F-61857ab9f0c4.reason: Same as F-0907fa584356: docs/items/ss-12-import-local.md defines the bulk POST /api/v1/import (one transaction, counts, conflicts reported instead of overwriting), so ss-12 does not depend on repeated PUTs. Decision 6's sentence about a 409 whose record equals the one sent is a rule for the import's conflict report. Wording only.

F-b7215ca28f16.reason: The approved plan is a record of what was planned; the ADR is the authority later slices read, and it states the final rule (an invalid JSON config goes to the online-only or configuration error). Changing the plan after approval would stale it and nothing a user sees depends on it.

F-f06b9fcae4ed.reason: A deliberate decision, not a defect: decision 9 never falls back to an empty local ledger when it cannot tell which deployment it is on, because that would diverge from the server. On a static host a passing 5xx or network error shows the online-only error until reload; this is rare today (no service worker) and the safe direction.
